Events in OWL/RDF

Released Aug 6, 2025, 23 min

Play Events in OWL/RDF on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

How do you model events and situations in OWL/RDF?

In this episode of Ontology Explained, we walk through a Davidsonian-style approach to representing actions and states using ttl (Turtle) syntax. Whether you're building a knowledge graph or designing an ontology for real-world data, this is a practical intro to event modeling in the Semantic Web stack.
